I have resolved the proxy authentication issue.

### Root Cause
When refactoring scheme prepending for proxy URLs to use `urllib3.util.parse_url` in [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///testbed/requests/utils.py#L960), the authentication component (`user:pass@`) was omitted when reconstructing `netloc` using `urlunparse`. Because `urllib3.util.Url.netloc` returns only `host:port` (unlike `urllib.parse.urlparse`'s `netloc` which includes `userinfo@host:port`), `auth` was lost when `prepend_scheme_if_needed` reconstructed the proxy URL. As a result, proxy credentials were not included in proxy requests, causing proxies to respond with `407 Proxy Authentication Required`.

### Fix
1. Updated [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///testbed/requests/utils.py#L960) to parse scheme-less URLs cleanly and include `auth` in `netloc` when formatting with `urlunparse`.
2. Updated [`get_auth_from_url`](file:///testbed/requests/utils.py#L988) in [`requests/utils.py`](file:///testbed/requests/utils.py) to safely handle `None` values for `parsed.username` and `parsed.password`.
3. Updated [`rebuild_proxies`](file:///testbed/requests/sessions.py#L296) in [`requests/sessions.py`](file:///testbed/requests/sessions.py) to check `if username:` when applying `Proxy-Authorization` headers, matching the logic in [`proxy_headers`](file:///testbed/requests/adapters.py#L389).
